titles.title: To The Ends Of The Earth

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Love unfailing
Overtaking my heart
You take me in

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Finding peace again
Fear is lost in all you are

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
And I would give the world
to tell your story

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
Cause I know that you've called me
I know that you've called me

verse.name: v1e
verse.lines:
I've lost myself for good within your promise
And I won't hide it
I won't hide it

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Jesus, I believe in You
And I would go

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
To the ends of the earth
To the ends of the earth

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
For you alone are the son of God
And all the world will see

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
That You are God
You are God
